TS0300001.message: A validation cron schedule needs five fields; this expression has {count}.
TS0300001.solution: Use minute, hour, day of month, month and day of week. Seconds and years are not supported.

TS0300002.message: Validation schedule field {field} has an invalid value `{value}` at position {position}.
TS0300002.solution: Check the field range and supported UNIX syntax, or choose an explicit IANA time zone. Technical details retain the parser cause.

TS0300003.message: The validation schedule has no possible calendar date.
TS0300003.solution: Check the selected months and days. Leap days are supported.

TS0300004.message: Validation schedule calculation reached its {limit} limit.
TS0300004.solution: This is a calculation limit, not proof of an invalid expression. Retry within the available calculation budget before enabling the schedule.

TS0300005.message: Validation execution at node {node} was cancelled before completion.
TS0300005.solution: A cancelled expansion is incomplete. Read the original run state before starting new work.

TS0300006.message: Source field {field} conflicts with a generated output field at node {node}.
TS0300006.solution: Inspect the source shape and declared expansion; do not overwrite the original field or treat the conflict as an empty result.

TS0300007.message: Validation cannot interpret {rule} for field {field} at node {node}.
TS0300007.solution: Use a supported validation rule; validation cannot execute production expressions as its reference.

TS0300008.message: Validation field {field} is missing or invalid.
TS0300008.solution: Correct the validation configuration or inspect the failed reader contract.

TS0300009.message: A validation key exceeds its {limit} limit.
TS0300009.solution: Use a supported bounded key; the validation cannot truncate identity values.

TS0300010.message: Validation key component {component} has an incompatible logical domain or shape.
TS0300010.solution: Confirm compatible source and destination key mappings and native ordering.

TS0300011.message: Validation cannot move from {from} to {to} in {mode} mode.
TS0300011.solution: Read the original run state before retrying the operation.

TS0300012.message: Validation read facts exceed their {limit} budget.
TS0300012.solution: Inspect the affected value or root size; validation cannot truncate facts to continue.

TS0300013.message: Validation cannot safely carry a value of type {type}.
TS0300013.solution: Use a connector codec that preserves this value in a supported portable form.

TS0300014.message: The validation owner for Pipeline {pipeline} is no longer authorized.
TS0300014.solution: The old validation run must end. Start a new run after the owner has been safely retired.

TS0300015.message: The independent validation read of {table} failed.
TS0300015.solution: Inspect the reader error and connection before starting another validation.

TS0300016.message: The validation reader for {table} violated its result-delivery contract.
TS0300016.solution: Check the connector's query implementation; incomplete data cannot be treated as EOF.

TS0300017.message: The independent validation read of {table} was cancelled.
TS0300017.solution: A cancelled read is incomplete; start a new validation when authorized.

TS0300018.message: Connector {connector} failed to convert validation field {field}.
TS0300018.solution: Inspect the codec failure; another codec cannot silently replace its result.

TS0300019.message: Connector {connector} did not provide a usable validation value for field {field}.
TS0300019.solution: Check the codec and logical type support. A missing result or raw driver value cannot establish equality.
